Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:
 Over Current Earth Fault Relay

MCGG 
 22
 GEC
Introduction

The MCGG is a microprocessor based over-current relay available in 
single, two, three or four pole versions manufactured by GEC ALSTHOM. Each pole 
is provided with a choice of four inverse time characteristics and three 
definite time characteristics as well as a trip test position. An instantaneous 
element is also available on each phase. The MCGG 22 is the single phase 
version.

This procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper 
operation and calibration of the MCGG22 relay. It is recommended this procedure 
be carried out on a yearly bases.

The document is formatted the way to minimize the possibility of error 
causing personal injury or damage to equipment.

The first draft initiated & tested by eng. 
Medhat Magdy Gerges, revised by eng. 
Abdel-Naser Moustafa Ahmed, accepted by eng. Shawky Attalla: general manager, approved by eng. Abdel Elmegeed Emara: head sector of SIDI KRIR 
Power Station, 
and certified by eng. Mona 
Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC consultant engineer 'A' and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.

The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety helmet, safety shoes ... ets

Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the relay 
 current circuits for test current
Switch off the DC power supply before inserting or withdrawing the relay

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Relays Preparation

items:
Review the manual and 
 drawings.

Carefully 
 follow these test procedure steps
Check the wires of the relay by hand.
Check the AC source is available to the tester.
Check the existence of the DC sources in panels.

Disconnect the trip leads of the relay and connect one of 
 them to the timer of the tester.

Check all the leads used in 
 tests.

Verify 
 the test results match the relay setting - If not consult technical 
 services.

Make 
 sure CT secondary circuits are shorted at the incoming terminal blocks 
 before isolating the relay current circuits for test.

Look at field 
 maintenance file and compare the position of the setting switches on relay 
 with those shown in the setting sheet

Testing 
Procedure(s)
Power Supply Test

Press the RESET button and check that all LEDs are 
illuminated. This confirms that all measuring boards are operating 
satisfactorily.

sections.text:
Current 
Pick-Up and Reset Check Test

Connect test leads between the current terminals on the 
relay as shown in drawing and the current terminals on the test set.

Slowly increase the current until the green LED lights. 
The relay must operate with a current between +/- 10% of the setting value.
Record this value on the test sheet.
Slowly decrease the current until the green LED reset.
Record this value on the test sheet.

sections.text:
Time Setting 
Test

Inject current into the relay and increase it to reach (5 
Is) . Keep this value and switch off the test set.

Connect the relay time delayed output contacts to the 
timer contacts of the test set.

Switch on the test set and inject current. The timer will 
stop after delay time(30sec).
Record this value on the test sheet.

Remove the leads from the time delayed contact and the 
test set.

sections.text:
Instantaneous 
Setting Test

Connect the instantaneous trip out put contacts to the timer contacts on the 
test set. This is to stop the current as soon as the relay picks up. 
CAUTION: Don't keep this current on the relay for more 
than a few seconds as it may exceed the rating and damage the relay.

Decrease the setting of
Is to 0.05 In.

Increase current quickly to reach (30 
Is). Keep this value and switch off the test set.

Connect the relay trip output contacts to the timer 
contacts of the test set.

Switch on the test set and inject current. The timer will 
stop instantaneous (50ms).
Record this value on the test sheet.

sections.text: Trip Test

items: Request the operator to switch on the main circuit breaker.

Operate the output auxiliary contact by injection to trip the circuit 
 breaker.
Check that the circuit breaker tripped.

sections.text:
Return the 
Relay and Power Equipment to Service

Verify the test result match the relay setting. If not 
consult technical services.
Test trip the circuit breaker associated with the relay.

Make a final check that all switches on the relay are set 
according to the setting sheet.
Make sure the CT secondary circuit is in normal condition

Remove the CT shorts which were installed in the Power 
Supply
Return the relay and power equipment to service.
